description: VOPP1 hydropathy, AlphaFold pLDDT disorder profile, and annotated linear motif map
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests
seq="MRRQPAKVAALLLGLLLECTEAKKHCWYFEGLYPTYYICRSYEDCCGSRCCVRALSIQRLWYFWFLLMMGVLFCCGAGFFIRRRMYPPPLIEEPAFNVSYTRQPPNPGPGAQQPGPPYYTDPGGPGMNPVGNSMAMAFQVPPNSPQGSVACPPPPAYCNTPPPPYEQVVKAK"
L=len(seq)
kd=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
h=np.array([kd[a] for a in seq])
def win(w): return np.array([h[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1].mean() for i in range(L)])
kd19, kd11 = win(19), win(11)
for w,arr in [(19,kd19),(11,kd11)]:
    print(f"window {w}: max in 1-25 = {arr[:25].max():.2f} at {arr[:25].argmax()+1}; "
          f"max in 55-85 = {arr[54:85].max():.2f} at {arr[54:85].argmax()+55}; "
          f"max in 86-172 = {arr[85:].max():.2f}")
print("segments with kd11 > 1.6:")
above=kd11>1.6; i=0
while i<L:
    if above[i]:
        j=i
        while j<L and above[j]: j+=1
        print(f"   {i+1}-{j}  peak {kd11[i:j].max():.2f}  {seq[i:j]}"); i=j
    else: i+=1

api=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q96AW1",timeout=120).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(api['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text
plddt=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
print("\npLDDT n=%d mean=%.1f frac<70=%.3f frac<50=%.3f"%(len(plddt),plddt.mean(),(plddt<70).mean(),(plddt<50).mean()))
# secondary structure from AlphaFold PDB HELIX/SHEET records
print("HELIX/SHEET records:")
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith(("HELIX","SHEET")): print("  ",l[:60])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13.5,9.5),sharex=True)
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(range(1,L+1),kd19,color="#2b6cb0",lw=1.8,label="window 19")
ax.plot(range(1,L+1),kd11,color="#90cdf4",lw=1.1,label="window 11")
ax.axhline(1.6,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax.axhline(0,c="k",lw=.6)
ax.fill_between(range(1,L+1),1.6,kd19,where=kd19>1.6,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=.25)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\nhydropathy")
ax.set_title("VOPP1 (Q96AW1, 172 aa): hydropathy, AlphaFold confidence, and linear motif map")
ax=axes[1]
ax.plot(range(1,L+1),plddt,color="#2f855a",lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(70,ls=":",c="#dd6b20",lw=1.2); ax.axhline(50,ls=":",c="#c53030",lw=1.2)
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(25,100)
ax.text(105,32,"58.1 %% of residues pLDDT < 70 (mean %.1f)"%plddt.mean(),fontsize=9,color="#c53030")
ax=axes[2]
for a,b,lab,c in [(1,22,"signal peptide","#cbd5e0"),(23,60,"Cys-rich ectodomain","#90cdf4"),
                  (61,81,"TM helix","#f6ad55"),(82,101,"juxtamembrane","#9ae6b4"),
                  (102,153,"Pro-rich disordered","#e9d8fd"),(154,172,"C-terminal PY region","#fbb6ce")]:
    ax.barh(0,b-a+1,left=a,height=.5,color=c,edgecolor="k",lw=.5)
    ax.text((a+b)/2,0,lab,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7)
for p,lab,c,yy in [(117,"PPYY 116-119\nnot conserved (18.5 %)\nY119A: no effect on WWOX","#718096",1.05),
                   (155,"PPAY 154-157 (PPSY in 22/27)\nPPxY class conserved\nY157A: no effect on WWOX","#6b46c1",1.05),
                   (163,"PPPY 162-165\nPPxY in 27/27 orthologs\nY165A: reduces WWOX binding","#c53030",-0.95),
                   (166,"YEQV 165-168 (YxxPhi)\nconserved 94.4 %","#2b6cb0",-1.75)]:
    ax.annotate(lab,xy=(p,0.26 if yy>0 else -0.26),xytext=(p,yy),ha="center",fontsize=7.2,color=c,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-",color=c,lw=1.1))
ax.plot([83.5],[0.28],marker="v",color="#2c7a7b",ms=7)
ax.text(84,0.52,"RRRM 82-85\n100 % conserved",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#2c7a7b")
ax.plot([171],[-0.28],marker="^",color="#b7791f",ms=7)
ax.text(171,-0.52,"K170/K172:\nonly cytoplasmic Lys",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#b7791f")
ax.set_ylim(-2.2,1.5); ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("residue number"); ax.set_xlim(0,182)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
